latin: Cum dixit Abucaten Auenan animam esse supra tempus, intelligendum est de anima absoluta secundum substantiam, praescindendo ab omni operatione quae competit ei inquantum est anima.
translation: When Abucaten Avenan says that the soul stands above time, take this of the soul considered in its bare substance, apart from any operation that belongs to it precisely as soul.
